title: Plan Artifact
description: Schema for plan-<timestamp>.md structured content. Decompose reads this to structure wave execution.

chosen_approach.description: One sentence: what will be built and how

conditions.description: Required when go_no_go = CONDITIONAL. Each condition must be verifiable before execution.

finding.description: One sentence: concern, confirmation, or risk

consequence.description: What happens if this risk materializes

adversary_receipt_path.description: Path to adversary receipt if Adversary was triggered. null otherwise.

grader_receipt_path.description: Path to grader receipt if Grader was triggered. null otherwise.
